Sandbox_PhotonSwordForms_FormMasteryDama: Each mastery level of the Form you fight with adds this much to the sword's damage in that Form (10 means +50% at full mastery). It stacks with Senator's Attack Damage sandbox multiplier.
Sandbox_PhotonSwordForms_ExtinguishWhile: Dodging with a lit photon sword (Martial Arts Core's dodge key while aiming) puts the blade out for the leap. Each player chooses in their mod options whether it relights when they land. Off: the blade stays lit through the dodge.
Sandbox_PhotonSwordForms_GuardDrainMulti: Scales how much a deflected bullet or soaked blast drains the guard meter (Martial Arts Core's block drain). 0 means gunfire never drains it.
